questions.question: Which service should I start with?
questions.answer: Start with the problem. Google Ads can reach people already searching, Meta Ads can introduce an offer, SEO improves the website’s organic search foundations, and website creation gives your services a clear home. We review your business before choosing a starting point.

questions.question: What information will you need from me?
questions.answer: Your website, main services, real service areas, customer type, available assets and business goal are useful starting points. For advertising, we also discuss a test budget and how you respond to enquiries.

questions.question: What is it like to work with you?
questions.answer: DigitalTalha is my personal brand. You work directly with me, with agreed scope, clear communication and reviews of what the available evidence shows.

work_directly_with_me_from: Work directly with me from planning to review.
reach_the_right_people_explain: Reach the right people. Explain your offer. Make the next step clear.
you_work_directly_with_me: You work directly with me on your ads, website and the thinking behind them.
i_m_a_bba_student: I’m a BBA student at Amity University with structured digital marketing training and hands-on practice in research, campaigns and conversion tracking. I start by understanding your business before choosing a channel or building a page.
help_more_customers_find_you: Help more customers find you and get in touch.
i_m_talha_alam_i: I’m a freelance digital marketer in India. I help small businesses get found and generate enquiries with Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO and mobile-friendly websites.
